The Court made the following
 Order:

Criminal Petition was filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (for brevity,
'Cr.P.C.'), challenging the registration of an FIR in Crime No.133 of 2020 on the file of Edlapadu Police Station, Guntur District, for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 120B, 420 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code (for brevity, 'the IPC').
2. Heard the learned counsel for the Petitioner and the learned Assistant Public Prosecutor.
3.

The learned Assistant Public Prosecutor, on instructions, submitted that after thorough investigation, a charge sheet was laid in the above-mentioned crime and the same was numbered as C.C.No.503 of 2021 on the file of the learned Additional Junior Civil Judge, Chilakaluripet and the said case is posted to 23.02.2026 for examination of the accused.

4. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the Criminal Petition is disposed of, granting liberty to the petitioner to challenge the proceedings in C.C.No.503 of 2021 on the file of the learned Additional Junior Civil Judge, Chilakaluripet, if so advised.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
DR. Y. LAKSHMANA RAO, J Date: 04.02.2026

SAK THE HONOURABLE DR JUSTICE Y. LAKSHMANA RAO CRIMINAL PETITION No.3955 of 2020 Date:
